description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git 'proc-receive' hooks, including setup functions, test execution, and repeated initialization for different protocols.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Initializes upstream and workbench Git repositories, creates commits, tags, remotes, and hooks for testing the 'proc-receive' hook.

methods.name: run_proc_receive_hook_test
methods.description: Runs tests for 'proc-receive' hook on either local or HTTP protocol, executing test scripts found in the designated test directories.
